features:
ForkyHUB — Sailor Piece 🏴‍☠️

Optimize your journey across the seven seas with ForkyHUB! Designed to be lightweight, fast, and undetected, ForkyHUB offers the best tools for you to dominate Sailor Piece with ease.

🛠️ Main Features:

Auto Farm (Mobile/PC): Smart quest system with optimized teleportation.

Multi-Boss Farm: Select multiple bosses simultaneously and farm them all in sequence.

Automation: Auto Skills, Auto Haki, and Auto-Open Chests.

Movement: Fly, Noclip, and Customizable Auto Dash (Speed and Distance).

Visuals: Full Player ESP with distance tracking.

Settings: Configuration system (Save/Load) and integrated Anti-AFK.

⚠️ Development & Support:

Constantly Evolving: ForkyHUB is under active development. We work daily to optimize existing functions and ensure the best experience possible.

Beta Phase: Since we are in continuous improvement, minor bugs may occur. If you find anything, please report it on our Discord so we can fix it immediately!

Upcoming Features: Several new features (New Islands, Fruit Farms, and Advanced Exploits) are already in production and will be available soon.
